top_story_title: No network device security news in this window
top_story_summary: Nothing in the last 24 hours concerned network infrastructure devices. The collector took 739 raw entries from 23 feeds, 35 of which were inside the window, and only one passed the topic filter - a syndicated infrastructure-management article about forgotten virtual machines and over-broad access permissions. It names no network vendor, no firewall, VPN gateway, router, switch, wireless controller or load balancer, and no CVE, so it is dropped rather than written up.
executive_summary: No network infrastructure device security news in the last 24 hours: 23 feeds polled, 35 fresh entries, nothing actionable for firewalls, VPN gateways, routers, switches, wireless or load balancers.
One collected item was dropped - an infrastructure-management piece about unmanaged virtual machines, not network device security.
No CVEs, no CISA KEV additions and no confirmed exploitation affecting network gear in this window.
No new AI item: the previous AI section is carried forward with the date it was written.
